Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misunderstood basic physics by focusing on vertical forces (increasing the normal force and friction) as a means to stop horizontal motion, leading to the incorrect selection of B. On a level surface, only a net force opposite the direction of motion will decelerate and stop the car, which corresponds to option D. The Planner also prematurely concluded the task without consulting other specialists or validating the reasoning.
